title: Oozy Smoky Spanish Beef Salmorejo
description: A smoky and juicy Spanish dish featuring ground beef and a blend of spices, served in a salmorejo form. This recipe is halal-friendly and uses ground nut oil for added flavor.
instructions: Heat the ground nut oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Add the ground beef to the skillet, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Once the beef is browned, add the smoked paprika, bhuna spice blend, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the tomato paste to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
While the beef mixture is cooking, toast the bread cubes in a toaster or under the broiler.
Once the bread is toasted, add it to the skillet with the beef mixture and stir to combine.
Let the mixture cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the bread is fully incorporated and the mixture is heated through.
Serve the salmorejo hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
